title: banksia longiflora
intro: Banksia longiflora, commonly known as the fern-leaved banksia, is a species of shrub in the plant family Proteaceae. This plant is known for its unique, fern-like leaves and conical shape, typically growing up to 2-5 meters in height. The health benefits of Banksia longiflora include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, while also potentially helping to lower cholesterol levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, as well as potential antioxidant and cardiovascular protective actions.
